Folders is the list of folders Sift imports your files from. To open it, go to [Settings > Folders](/settings/library).

Come here to add a folder to your library, scan one again, or remove one. Sift imports what is in a folder you add, and new files as they appear in it.

![The Folders pane in Settings](../../../assets/screens/settings-library.jpg)

## On this pane

The pane holds these, in this order:

- **Add a folder**: opens the folder chooser. The folder you choose is added to your library and its files are imported.
- **Your folders**: one row for each folder in your library, with its location. Click a row to see the folders inside it.
- <a id="library.storage_folders"></a>**Sift data**: in the Sift app on your computer, the two folders where Sift keeps its own data, separate from your media.
- <a id="library.save_folder"></a>**Save files to**: in the Sift app, the folder a file you save to your computer goes to. It's your Downloads folder unless you choose another.

## The menu on a folder

Click **More** at the end of a folder's row, or right-click the row, to choose one of these:

- **Scan now**: reads the folder again for new, changed and removed files.
- **It moved**: shown when Sift can't reach the folder. Tell Sift where the folder is now.
- **Auto-enrich this folder**: looks up the folder's files on your stash-boxes. Only an admin sees it.
- **Hide** or **Unhide**: takes the folder's files into Hidden, or brings them back.
- **Sharing**: chooses which guests can see the folder and everything in it.
- **Visibility**: shows who can see the folder and what decides it.
- **Don't enrich** or **Allow enrichment**: keeps the folder's files from being looked up on a stash-box, or lets them be looked up again.
- **Don't swap** or **Allow swapping**: keeps the folder's files out of a swap, or lets them be sent again.
- **Remove**: takes the folder out of your library. You confirm first, and your files stay on the disk.

Nothing on this pane is a stored setting.
